kobo.description: Configure Kobo device integration to sync your library books and reading progress with your Kobo e-reader.

sync.description: Enable and configure synchronization between your Booklore library and Kobo device.

admin.title: Administrator Settings
admin.description: Configure advanced Kobo sync settings that affect all users on this server.

syncEnabled.label: Enable Kobo Sync
syncEnabled.description: Turn on synchronization to automatically sync your library books to your Kobo device.

autoAddToShelf.label: Auto-Add New Books to Kobo Shelf

description.line1: When enabled, newly added books will be automatically added to your Kobo shelf for syncing.
description.line2: This eliminates the need to manually add each book to the shelf.

token.label: Kobo Sync Token
token.description: Your unique sync token for authenticating with your Kobo device. Keep this secure.

tokenManagement.label: Token Management
tokenManagement.description: Regenerate your sync token if needed. This will invalidate the current token.

progressReading.label: Mark as Reading at: {{percent}}%

description.line1: Books are marked as "Reading" when progress exceeds this percentage. This helps automatically track which books you've started.

progressReading.recommended: 1% (default) - marks as reading after the first page or two.

progressFinished.label: Mark as Finished at: {{percent}}%

description.line1: Books are marked as "Finished" when progress reaches this percentage. Accounts for books where the last few pages are acknowledgments or index.

progressFinished.recommended: 99% (default) - marks as finished when nearly complete.

convertToKepub.label: Convert to KEPUB
convertToKepub.pros: KEPUB format enables enhanced Kobo features like better typography, reading stats, and faster page turns.
convertToKepub.cons: Conversion takes extra processing time and may occasionally fail for complex layouts.
convertToKepub.note: Books over the size limit below will skip conversion automatically.

conversionLimit.label: Conversion Size Limit: {{size}} MB

description.line1: Large files (100MB+) can cause conversion timeouts and server strain. Lower limits ensure faster syncing but may skip conversion of larger books.

conversionLimit.recommended: 50-100MB for most libraries. Very large books will sync as regular EPUB regardless of this setting.

description.line1: Force enable hyphenation. Otherwise, hyphenation is only enabled when text alignment on the Kobo device is explicitly set to

convertCbx.label: Convert CBX to EPUB
convertCbx.description: Converts CBX files to EPUB during Kobo sync, allowing CBX files to be downloaded and read on Kobo devices.

imageCompression.label: Conversion image compression: {{percent}}%
imageCompression.description: Comic book conversions can sometimes result in very large files. This setting allows you to compress the images during conversion to prevent size from shooting up.

cbxConversionLimit.label: CBX Conversion Size Limit: {{size}} MB

description.line1: Comic book archives can be very large due to high-resolution images. Set a reasonable limit to prevent server overload during conversion.

cbxConversionLimit.recommended: 100-200MB for most comic libraries. CBX files over this limit will not be converted or synced to the device.

regenerate.description: Regenerates cover images for all books from the embedded covers in the file.

verticalCropping.label: Vertical Cover Cropping
verticalCropping.description: Automatically crop extremely tall images (like web comics) from the top to create usable cover thumbnails.

horizontalCropping.label: Horizontal Cover Cropping
horizontalCropping.description: Automatically crop extremely wide images from the left to create usable cover thumbnails.

aspectRatioThreshold.label: Aspect Ratio Threshold: {{value}}
aspectRatioThreshold.description: Images with aspect ratios exceeding this threshold will be cropped. A value of 2.5 means images more than 2.5x taller (or wider) than normal will be cropped.

smartCropping.label: Smart Cropping
smartCropping.description: Skip uniform colour regions when determining where to crop. Focuses the cover image on the most relevant content.

autoBookSearch.label: Auto Book Search

similarBookRecommendation.label: Similar Book Recommendation
similarBookRecommendation.description: Enables or disables similar book recommendations based on your library.

maxFileUploadSize.label: Max File Upload Size
maxFileUploadSize.description: Defines the maximum allowed size (in MB) for each uploaded file. Applies to EPUB, PDF, CBZ, CBR, and CB7 formats.
maxFileUploadSize.restartWarning: Changes will take effect after restarting the server

enableTelemetry.label: Enable Telemetry
enableTelemetry.description: Help improve Booklore by sharing anonymous usage statistics. This data lets the developers see which features are most used, identify bugs, and spot performance issues so they know what to work on next. No personal information, book content, or any identifiable data is ever sent. Data is sent to the Booklore server automatically once every 24 hours. It’s completely safe and very helpful to the developers.

metadata.description: Configure how metadata is retrieved, stored, and managed for your books. Set up automatic downloads, persistence options, and provider preferences.

bookdrop.description: Automatically downloads metadata from your configured sources (Amazon, Goodreads, etc.) when files are added to the Bookdrop folder. Use with caution if adding many files at once as metadata fetching can take time.

libraryMetadata.title: Library Metadata Configuration
libraryMetadata.description: Configure metadata fetch behavior for your libraries. Set global defaults and create library-specific overrides to control how book metadata is retrieved from different providers.

description.line1: Set global default provider priorities for book metadata fields. These settings apply to all libraries unless overridden below.
description.line2: BookLore tries providers from left to right (1st → 2nd → 3rd → 4th priority) for each book field until it finds data.
description.line3: The system checks your 1st priority provider first. If that provider doesn't have the specific field (like description or author), it automatically moves to your 2nd priority, then 3rd, and finally 4th.
description.line4: Leave a priority empty to skip it entirely. For example, if Amazon (1st) has no description but Google Books (2nd) does, Google's description will be used.
description.line5: Use the Enable checkboxes to completely disable fetching for specific fields.
description.line6: Disabled fields will be skipped entirely regardless of provider settings.

description.line1: Override the default priority settings for specific libraries. Each library can have its own provider priority order while falling back to defaults for unspecified fields.
description.line2: You can also enable or disable specific metadata fields per library.

warning.title: Network Storage Warning:
warning.body: These features directly modify and move book files on disk (including rewriting metadata and renaming files). They are designed for local file systems only. Using them on NAS or cloud-backed storage is untested and may lead to file corruption, incomplete writes, or permanent data loss. GitHub issues related to network storage will not be supported.

scope.title: Reader Settings Scope
scope.description: Select whether to apply the same reader settings (font, theme, spread, zoom, etc.) globally for all books or individually per book.

pdf.label: PDF Reader Settings
pdf.description: Choose how PDF reader settings are applied across your library.

epub.label: EPUB Reader Settings
epub.description: Choose how EPUB reader settings are applied across your library.

cbx.label: CBX Reader Settings
cbx.description: Choose how CBX (comic book) reader settings are applied across your library.

epubGlobal.title: EPUB Preferences: Global
epubGlobal.description: Set default reading options that will apply to all EPUB books in your library, including font, theme, text flow, and layout preferences.

pdfGlobal.title: PDF Preferences: Global
pdfGlobal.description: Set default reading options that apply to all PDF books in your library, including zoom level, page layout, and navigation behavior.

cbxGlobal.title: CBX Preferences: Global
cbxGlobal.description: Configure default reading settings for all comic books in your library, including page layout, reading direction, and image scaling.

customFonts.title: Custom Fonts Management
customFonts.description: Upload and manage up to 10 custom fonts for a personalized reading experience in the EPUB reader. Each font can then be selected in the EPUB reader settings.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Choose the visual theme for EPUB reading experience.

font.label: Font
font.description: Select the font family for text display.

flow.label: Flow
flow.description: Configure text flow and reading direction.

pageSpread.label: Page Spread
pageSpread.description: Choose between single page or double page spread view.

fontSize.label: Font Size
fontSize.description: Adjust the text size for comfortable reading.

pageSpread.label: Page Spread
pageSpread.description: Choose how PDF pages are displayed - single page or double page spread view.

pageZoom.label: Page Zoom
pageZoom.description: Set the default zoom level for PDF documents to enhance readability.

pageSpread.label: Page Spread
pageSpread.description: Configure how comic book pages are displayed - single page or double page spread.

pageLayout.label: Page Layout
pageLayout.description: Choose how comic pages are displayed while reading.

fitMode.label: Fit Mode
fitMode.description: Select how images should be scaled to fit the reader window.

scrollMode.label: Scroll Mode
scrollMode.description: Choose between paginated or infinite scroll reading experience.

backgroundColor.label: Background Color
backgroundColor.description: Set the background color for the comic reader.

viewPreferences.title: Library and Shelf View & Sort Preferences
viewPreferences.description: Configure default and per-library/shelf preferences for sorting and view mode (grid or table) in the browser.

default.title: Default Settings
default.description: Set the default sorting and view preferences that will apply to all libraries and shelves unless overridden.

overrides.title: Specific Overrides
overrides.description: Create specific sorting and view preferences for individual libraries or shelves that override the default settings.

description.defaultPreferences: Configure the default sorting field, direction, and view mode for all libraries and shelves.

sidebarSortingPreferences.title: Sidebar Library and Shelf Sorting Preference
sidebarSortingPreferences.description: Configure sorting options for your library and shelves names shown in the left menu sidebar.
